summary: Dynamic backend testing of the SENDER_EMAIL sandbox-override fix (server.py lines 45-58) + full regression of email-verification suite + 7 live endpoint regressions. ALL 25 TESTS PASS (3 boot scenarios + 15 email-verification + 7 live regressions). The override correctly: (a) preserves an explicit verified sender, (b) replaces the Resend sandbox with noreply@casforensics.org, (c) falls back to all four defaults when env is empty. Live endpoints confirm SITE_URL is used in sitemap (https://casforensics.org/techniques/...) and forgot-password (debug_link points at casforensics.org). Seed idempotency exactly matches the expected {inserted:0, updated:23, total:23}.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py lines 49-54 sandbox-override block is correct & defensive: empty string OR 'onboarding@resend.dev' both trigger the swap to noreply@casforensics.org. Idempotent across multiple imports.
SENDER_FROM (line 59) correctly composes 'Casino Spotter <noreply@casforensics.org>' and skips the wrap if the user already supplied a bracketed string — good.
resend_send() helper (line 65) auto-injects From + Reply-To on every send — eliminates the risk of any code path bypassing the verified domain.

SITE_URL is consistently used at 3 sites: onboarding email (line 616), _resolve_origin fallback (line 718), sitemap (line 2596). Confirmed via live curl that sitemap emits https://casforensics.org/techniques/... URLs not the preview host.
server.py is still ~2849 lines — splitting into routers (auth, live, legitimacy, stripe, seo, affiliates, scam_wall) remains overdue. Carried over from iteration_6.

test_sender_override.py uses subprocess to launch fresh python interpreters with patched env vars so each scenario gets a clean module import — load_dotenv(override=False) means in-process re-import wouldn't have re-evaluated the override block.

seed_data_creation: test_iter7_live_regression.py creates one ephemeral TEST_iter7_<hex>@cs.io user per run (unverified). It also calls db.signup_attempts.delete_many({}) to bypass the IP-based 5/hour rate limit before its signup test. No other DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run all three suites in this order for fast regression: (1) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sender_override.py (boot/env) — 3 tests, ~7s; (2) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_email_verification.py — 15 tests, ~40s; (3) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_live_regression.py — 7 tests, ~2s. Total: 25 tests, ~50s. The boot tests spawn child python processes with patched env, so they don't pollute the parent shell. The live regression test wipes db.signup_attempts before its signup test — if you add more signup tests, do the same. To verify the actual production fix from the host: `curl -s $BACKEND_URL/api/auth/forgot-password -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"casforensics@gmail.com"}' | jq` — must show email_sent=true.
rca of the issue: Original problem: production .env still carried SENDER_EMAIL=onboarding@resend.dev (Resend sandbox), which rejects emails to non-team recipients, blocking real-user signup verification. Fix in /app/backend/server.py lines 49-54 checks the env value at boot and silently rewrites the sandbox sender to noreply@casforensics.org (the verified domain). Validated by spawning a child python with the bad env var and asserting server.SENDER_EMAIL is the verified one. All three env scenarios (explicit-verified, stale-sandbox, empty) end up with SENDER_EMAIL=noreply@casforensics.org. Live curl against the preview backend confirms forgot-password sends successfully (email_sent=true).
